title: Alarm Manager — drop massive FTTH Agora ONU and HFC cable-modem noise
sampleNotes: Built from ~800 live tail samples (4x200 msgs) via Kafka Atlas on Rednet. FTTH-AGORA-SNMP and ONU/GPON specificProblem values were consistently present. HFC cable-modem subsystems were not observed in the sample window — HFC subsystem names below are placeholders to validate against your Alarm Manager probe list before prod.
semantics: ALARMS_TO_ZTR filter: first matching rule wins; no match drops the record. Rules are an allowlist — each rule describes a slice of alarms to KEEP. Order matters: broad non-noisy subsystems pass first; Agora/HFC slices only apply when earlier rules did not match.
onuSpecificProblems: RX GPON optical signal above rated value
RX GPON optical signal below rated value

rules._comment: Pass everything not sourced from high-volume FTTH Agora or HFC CM probes.
Agora: pass when the trap is not a per-ONU/GPON customer alarm.
values: RX GPON optical signal above rated value
RX GPON optical signal below rated value

rules._comment: Agora: pass when managed object is not ONU/PON (keeps OLT/chassis-level).
Agora: pass non-GPON technology (undef on OLT/syslog-derived alarms).
HFC: pass when managed object is not a cable modem class (keeps CMTS/headend).
HFC: pass when specificProblem is not a known per-modem flap/noise trap.
